body:
16 Nov 2026 night, P2-25 slices 2+3, PR #110 FIX ROUND (built, not walked; not deployed; still a draft; merges LAST, after #107 and #111; N-34's files and rows untouched, as ruled).
1 THE GUARD COVERS KEY CREATION. The server REFUSES TO START (create_app and python -m encore_server, first of all, before anything is opened) on any Python whose Unicode is not 15.0.0 = Python 3.12 = python:3.12-slim; the message names Python 3.12 and how to get it. The test run stops at its first line with the same text (the old 3.13 venv ends in 2 s); requires-python is >=3.12,<3.13; the move-together test also covers server-image.yml and the integration test image. NO switch. The test-side tolerance of 15.1.0 is deleted. Why a pin and not a table: textnorm uses unicodedata as an algorithm (NFKC, NFD, NFC, category, case folding). Cost of a Python bump: one PR (generator, TEXTNORM_REVISION up so every install rekeys, image + server.yml + requires-python + constant together); docs/18 "the Unicode pin". DEV VENV: C:/dev/venv-encore-server-312 (uv Python 3.12.13, the old venv's pins). The 3.13 venv cannot run the suite after the merge. TRAP: the editable install points at ONE folder: PYTHONPATH, no -I, repoint with pip install --no-deps -e (live clone)/server/encore_server when the worktree goes.
2 ROLLBACK HOLE CLOSED. keyrepair.plan runs at every start (0.07 s on 3,394 refs; second start 0.074 s, writes nothing). After the first start only a STALE key is rewritten and judged (else the worklist the rehome empties would refill and a correct picture would be voided at every start: both tested); a newer revision is never planned against. COPY: an unfinished attempt's copy is reused, a spent one (name in setting.textnorm_backup_used, same transaction) never, at most 3 kept (Database.prune_backups, own label only). A failing repair x5 = one copy, one ERROR line per start. COST: a reused copy can be older than the start that used it.
INVARIANT (docs/18): the stored key is always norm_key(first artist, title); a later item that rewrites a title or artists (N-26 slice 5, N-28) must rewrite the key in the same transaction, else the next start rekeys it, takes a copy and (non-Latin) lists it and voids its picture.
3 SECOND SUSPECT REASON: a degenerate STORED key (slipknot||sic) makes a ref suspect; on the worklist when it has a library file; the hold is tested on each side alone for both reasons.
4 DOCS: RELEASE-CANDIDATE 4b: slice 4 is a RELEASE GATE for slice 3. AUDIT B-136 (plain YouTube scorer; run: another song on the artist channel at the same length 8.68, a one-Han-character substring title 4.5, both accepted); NOT fixed. B-136 was free everywhere at the last fetch: renumber if another PR took it. TO FILE: its fix (a corpus of wrong-song uploads first, the title gates, MATCHER_REVISION up).
5 DRY RUN again on a fresh copy of VM 108's database (original hash unchanged): 3,394 refs; 40 keys change (A 7, B 8, C 1, D 24); suspect 15 -> 16 (class C counts now); worklist still 0 (that song has only a keeper file); pictures voided 7 -> 8; 64 key groups before and after, 1 new; refmerge 0 merged, 6 held, same with and without the worklist; a simulated rollback ref is repaired in 0.27 s with its own new copy. Report: local/p225s23-dryrun-report-round2-2026-11-16.md.
6 CLASS D (24 of 40) IS A FIX: the curly apostrophe now keys like the straight one (the old fold dropped it: dont vs don t). 25 refs carry one: old fold different for 24, new fold the same for 25 of 25.
GATES (Python 3.12): server suite 2302 passed, 13 deselected (integration), 1 xfailed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (the run of the code tree d6868f4); ruff, format, mypy, gen_text_fold_table --check, check_rows, check_order clean; Dart text_fold_test + 4 fixture tests 258 pass. Seen RED on old code (34 failed), 22 of 22 mutations red.
NOT DONE: slice 4, the phone's normalizeForMatch, B-136's fix, walking, deploying. LEAD: the standing brief and memory still name the 3.13 venv.
